description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the lands acquired in Wathugedara, Kandegoda, Balapitiya D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with the acquisition of specific land parcels, compensation deposits for land acquisition, and detailed descriptions of land properties including location, boundaries, and extent.
